name: VOODOO
tagline: Flutes, sitar, oud, kalimba, erhu and a voodoo choir: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Flutes, sitar, oud, kalimba, erhu and choir
gumroad_title: VOODOO - World Instrument Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | World, Afrobeat, Trap, Cinematic
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (Flute, Pan Flute, Shakuhachi, Sitar, Oud, Kalimba, Erhu and Voodoo Choir) and 70 factory presets.
about: VOODOO, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines (Flute, Pan Flute, Shakuhachi, Sitar, Oud, Kalimba, Erhu and Voodoo Choir), shape it with five character controls (BREATH, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter, a volume envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb. The character is mystic and worldly, from Indian and Arabic strings to African kalimba and Andean flutes.
62 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode and 8 in Mono mode, so you can play chords or single-note lines from the first preset.
Built for world-music melodies, Afrobeat and Latin hooks, Trap and Drill ethnic toplines, cinematic and ritual atmospheres.

features.d: Flute, pan flute, shakuhachi, sitar with jawari buzz, oud, kalimba, erhu and voodoo choir.
BREATH, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from flutes and raga strings to African and Latin sounds, mystic pads, bass plucks and textures.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with the cutoff following the keyboard.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: VOODOO plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .voodoopreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
